reviews.review: How'd I get outta this chicken ♥♥♥♥ swarm

now now.. I know you All think I don't recommend this game.. but its because this game doesn't really have much fun.
and what I mean by that is this game doesn't offer anything new, lets just say you have over 1000 hours on this game, and its the only game in your library you like, now your ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ bored of it. you check to see if there's anymore new content and BAM its empty, darker than pitch black over used coal, there's no DLC no grinding no leaderboard, the only FUN you get from this game is when you play online and by which I mean playing with friends on the same level all of you played OVER AND OVER AGAIN.
so.. what is anyone getting from this review? is that this is a free game no story no DLC nothing, no one at valve is supporting it, or even giving away content, so you could pretty much get bored EASILY on this game after a few min and also on top of that the game is NEARLY dead most of the servers your gonna see and gonna enjoy are empty

now guess what.. why is this game nearly dead? its because like I said, there's no new Content.
 no content to bring back people to play the game, they easily get bored of it.
and believe me if they added a workshop for this game this game will be thriving as much as Left 4 Dead 2 or Garry's Mod.
and EVEN WORSE! this game doesn't have any updates no bug fixes NOTHING! its been like what 2 years!?!?! and they didn't add any bug fixes?!?! or updates! the last update we got (which surprisingly let me tell you, is the first ever update which is again also the last) AND may I tell you that update was a small update with only 3 new small things

1 - security fixes to client/server file transfers

2 - Fixed "Out of thread ids" error when launching Alien Swarm on a computer with 32 or more logical processors

3 - Updated localization files

now... lets get into the REAL review, what I said right now before is just a quick summary and NOTE if you wanna play this game and love it and have fun with the community

Graphics - They Are Polished And Decent Also Shiny And Clean And Thankfully There Are No Visual Issues Or Visual Glitches, Post Processing Is Also Adding Bloom, Depth Of Field And Many Stuff To Make The Game Actually Look Pretty!
+2 Rating (now its 2/10)

Sound - Sound Is A Important Part Of This Game, You Use It To Hear And Know If There's A Enemy In front Of A Door, and it is visual and works on the surroundings if you have good headphones all maxed up on volume then your gonna have one hell of a ride when playing solo on hardest difficulty and your in a dark place, its also good and clean and very clear on what your hearing.
+2 Rating (now its 4/10)

Gameplay - Is At It's Core, And Is Clean And Smooth And Fun! No Issues On It. Its Not Much, Its Kind Of The Same Thing Over And Over Again When Playing More And More And Gets A Bit Boring After Playing Too Much
+1 Rating ( Now Its 5/10, it was supposed to be 2+ Rating But due to the amount of times that nothing changes And Gets Boring after too much gameplay)

Content - this one is a roadblock there is NO content whatsoever! no new updates no patches no fixes nothing! that you will be able to sometimes see people exploiting the game to win!
0 Rating (still 5/10 If It Was Good 1 Rating Would've Been Added)

Atmosphere - its Perfect! in the first level when its all just cold and snowy and icy you can hear the sound and the wind it makes, inside however is dark and sometimes shows You Dead body's and corpses on the floor and mostly in the dark and the footsteps too are very dynamic and Adds more to the tension!! and opening sealed shut doors with tools of your team feels very Long to do but in the end its very short time needed to unlock one! like these 10-20 seconds will be the most longest seconds in your entire life! adding hordes of aliens and bugs onto the team adds ALOT to the tension!

+2 Ratings! ( now its 7/10! )

Experience - seeing long hallways and corpses lying around in the facilities and labs really does create a creepy vibe!
Shooting On Fast Bugs And Aliens Dashing Towards You In A Dead End While One Of The Team Member Tries To Open The Sealed Door Behind Really Adds To The Experience That You And The Team May Not Really Survive All together And Come Out Alive In The End!, The "Director" Similar To Left 4 Dead 2's One Creates Much Different Experiences Every Time You Restart Or Play A Level So You May Not Really Feel Bored Every Time!

2+ Ratings! (now its 9/10!)

Conclusion : this game is not really all that bad, yes it can get boring after many times of playing Over And Over Again.
And Not Supporting It With New Content Or Updates Or Patches really Does in fact ruin some of the fun it could've gotten
that way.
this game earns a 9/10!
i do not know how or when i got this but i do not remember buying it, although to whom ever is reading this, it look's like a good game in my opinion
